title: A/R Collection lists past-due invoices and credits only
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in to ShopView as an Admin user.
  • Customer X has: invoice A 5 days past due; invoice B due today; invoice C due next week; an unused credit memo from last week.
custom_steps:
1. Open the Reports menu.
  2. Click "A/R Aging Collection" in the left list.
  3. Open customer X's group.
  4. Read its lines.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 4:

  • invoice A and the credit memo are listed; invoice B (due today) and invoice C (not yet due) are not.

Why this matters: The collection list is for money that is already late.

V1 code, quoted: `if ($invoice->getPastDue($asOfDate) <= 0) { continue; }`

This is the expected behaviour as per the V1 code baseline AR-AP-V1-BASELINE.md (INV-101, INV-102) for epic SV-11315; the A/R and A/P Report Sorting PRD v12 (Confluence 947650561) does not change it. Last checked against build v26.45.4-b8c04e2 (staging) on 11/12/2026.
